MemoryGate.description: `[memory]`: how long a command waits in the memory gate.

give_up_after.description:
How long `priory memory acquire` without `--timeout` waits for its grant before it exits 75
and says to run the command on CI, at most 1 hour; it never does when unset.

Platform.description: The machine's operating system and CPU architecture.

arch.description: The CPU architecture, such as `x86_64` or `aarch64`.

Share.description: Shares such as `60%`, above 0 and at most 100%.

cpu.description: The fraction of the machine's CPUs the runner's agents may load together.

memory.description: The fraction of the machine's memory the runner's agents may take together.

description:
`runners/<tailscale-hostname>.toml` or `.yaml`: a machine that runs agents. Capacity is
measured live, so the file holds the platform and the share its agents may take.

agents.description: The share of the machine its agents may take together; 90% of each when unset.

title: runner
